lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh flake.lock (the nixpkgs pin) weekly. Only the nix manager has a lock file here: the Go module has no third-party dependencies.

customManagers.description: Go tools run in workflows as `go run <module>/cmd/<tool>@<version>` (staticcheck, govulncheck). Versions must be module versions (v0.8.2, not 2026.2.2).

packageRules.description: Keep the go directive as the minimum language version; only the toolchain line tracks new releases.

Move the go.mod toolchain (CI and release binaries), the Docker build image and the CI Go tools together so they never drift apart; a new Go release often needs a new staticcheck. flake.nix names its Go version (buildGo127Module, go_1_27) and needs a manual edit for a new minor release.
